summary: An Apollo-style probe that reads only the last 8 tokens of the reply, not the mean over all reply tokens. The threshold and the choice of probe use the same readout.

links.title: Goldowsky-Dill et al., Detecting Strategic Deception Using Linear Probes (2025)

recipe.summary: The fit of the harness's Apollo recipe: instructed pairs, a difference in means and logistic regressions on 8 layers. The change is the readout: the probe scores the mean of the activations of the last 8 reply tokens. The Alpaca threshold and the choice of probe on the validation split use the same readout.
recipe.fitData: The true facts of L1Fthrasir/Facts-true-false as instructed pairs, and the subject model's Alpaca replies for the threshold.
recipe.selection: TAIL = 8 is fixed before any run (the author's hypothesis). The threshold is at a 1% positive rate on the Alpaca replies. The layer and the probe type are chosen on the Varied Deception validation split.
recipe.evalItemsUsed: none. Only the validation split, which the harness permits.
recipe.compute: On one RTX PRO 6000, for Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 9 minutes for the fit and 10 minutes for the full run (results.json). On an RTX 5090 with the slow reference kernels for linear attention, 13 and 15 minutes.
